about: 内核怎么读正则，每一条都是拿最新的内核（tuoro/kixdns 的 main）跑出来的（kernel 记下提交），scripts/kernel-regex-cases.py 重新生成（要加用例就往下面加一行再跑）。patterns 里 kind 为 domain 的放进三份最小配置跑 config::validate（规则的 domain_regex、入口的 domain_regex、回答条件的 request_domain_regex，三处结果一样）；kind 为 txt 的放进 response_txt_content 的 regex：内核先看长度，超过 1000 字节不收，再和域名的正则一样按 1 MB 编译，编不出的原因前面加「invalid regex: 」。error 是内核报的原因（去掉前面的「compile configuration: 」），null 是内核收。blocklist 里每条写成拦截列表合并文件里的一条 regexp:，让内核读 GeoSite JSON，used 是内核用没用上它（\w、\d、\s、\b 内核先改成 ASCII 的写法再编译）。面板服务端的正则检查（crates/panel-server/src/regex_check.rs）和页面（web/src/config-model/regex-check.ts）都拿它测 / How the kernel reads regexes: each entry came from running the latest kernel (tuoro/kixdns main; kernel records the commit); scripts/kernel-regex-cases.py regenerates them (add a line below and run it to add a case). A domain case in patterns went into three minimal configs through config::validate (domain_regex in a rule, domain_regex in an entry, request_domain_regex in an answer condition, which agree); a txt case into response_txt_content in regex mode: the kernel refuses one over 1000 bytes long, then compiles it within the 1 MB of name regexes, prefixing the cause of a refusal with 「invalid regex: 」. error is the cause the kernel gives (without the leading 「compile configuration: 」), null that the kernel takes it. Each blocklist entry was written as one regexp: of the blocklists' merged file and read by the kernel as GeoSite JSON; used says whether the kernel kept it (the kernel rewrites \w, \d, \s and \b to ASCII before compiling). The panel server regex check and the page are both tested on it.
